prd: UI1: ledger port menu — paged book UI replacing the flat dock panel
rulings: Carl: menu becomes tabs/pages navigated left↔right; a Ship page and a Goods/Commodities page (+ more); buy/sell chosen WITHIN a page, not one global keybind per action; quantities 1 / 10 / custom
Noah: art direction = Captain's Ledger (book, page-flip); v1 pages = 1 Ship (repair/restock) · 2 Goods (buy/sell) · 3 Tavern; quantity input = 1 / 10 / MAX buttons only (no custom entry)
Fleet menu stays a separate screen (prior ruling) — NOT a book page
All styling/timing/pricing values PLACEHOLDER — live feel-tune

header (persistent on every page): Port name + type, gold, page bookmarks (3 tabs drawn as ledger bookmarks; active one raised), [F] DEPART wax-seal (bottom-right, doubles as touch target)
page 1 — SHIP: Each row: current/max, unit cost, projected cost at the selected quantity
MAX = min(need, affordable); repair MAX = full hull, repair 1/10 = HP chunks (PLACEHOLDER chunk size)
page 2 — GOODS: One row per commodity: name · port stock · buy quote · sell quote · your hold count
Stock + quotes come straight from PortEconomy/EMPIRE-1 (finite stock respected; sold-out rows show '—' on buy)
Buy/sell resolved per row with the selected quantity; MAX buy = min(hold space, port stock, affordable), MAX sell = your count
page 3 — TAVERN: TavernSystem.boardText content re-laid as a page: rumor, offers (stable slots + ACCEPTED flags from I27), YOUR LOG
Accept = select offer row + activate; the [T] toggle key is retired (FLAG U4: keep as a jump-to-page-3 shortcut?)

input_model.keyboard: ←/→ (and Q/E) flip pages · ↑/↓ select row · Z cycles quantity 1→10→MAX (persistent, shown as a pressed chip) · B buy / S sell (Goods) or Enter = row's single action (Ship/Tavern) · F depart. Total live binds in-menu: 8, replacing today's per-action number keys
input_model.touch: Tap bookmarks or edge arrows to flip · tap row to select · tap qty chip · tap BUY/SELL chips · tap seal to depart — routed through the existing TouchInput layer
input_model.m8_compliance: Page text rebuilds at HUD_TEXT_INTERVAL_MS and immediately on any input event (flip/select/transaction), same gate pattern as the current dock panel

ledger_skin_v1: Parchment field: flat warm fills + ink-line rules drawn with Phaser Graphics (no texture assets in v1); dashed row rules; wax-seal depart = drawn circle + anchor glyph
Serif face via one Google Fonts <link> in index.html (IM Fell English + Alegreya), fontFamily in text styles, system-serif fallback if the font hasn't loaded (FLAG U2)
Page flip v1 = quick slide+fade tween between page renders (FLAG U1: real curl animation later); flip sound hook left as a no-op
flags: FLAG U1: page-flip animation — v1 slide/fade vs full curl effect
FLAG U2: font loading — Google Fonts link vs bundled woff vs system serif only
FLAG U3: where port capture/defense status lives — Ship page footer for now vs a future 4th Port page (SV1 saves, PR #48, would join as a page in the same pass)
FLAG U4: retire [T] fully vs keep as jump-to-tavern shortcut
out_of_scope_v1: SV1 save page (lands as page 4 with PR #48's build)
